expect.notes: Six runs, selected by SUMER_FIXTURE_RUN (0-5); see the 'families' block for which triple of runs belongs to which cursor family. exact: the *_before run serves page 1 (e1,e2, next cursor h100) then EXITS instead of answering the h100 request -- the runner must kill/observe the crash, spawn *_after fresh, and resend cursor h100; *_after has no rule for anything except cursor h100/h200, so it will visibly fail (FIXTURE BUG stderr line, err.code=internal) if the runner resends anything else, which is the intended trip-wire for 'no event strictly before the resume cursor is re-emitted'. batch_restart: the *_before run serves the WHOLE first batch (f1,f2, next 'continue', batch NOT finished) then exits when asked to continue; because batch_restart only advances the durable cursor on next:null, the correct resume request is the ORIGINAL window request (not the 'continue' cursor) -- *_after's only rule matches that original window shape and re-serves f1+f2 before f3, exercising idempotent re-delivery rather than the exact family's no-reemission guarantee (which explicitly does NOT apply to batch_restart).
